question: Seven boxes D, E, F, G, I, J and K are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. No box is kept above F. Only three boxes are kept between F and K. Only one box is kept between D and E. E is kept immediately above K. Only four boxes are kept between D and G. J is kept at some place above I. Which box is kept second below J?
solution:

1) No box is kept above F.
